Una nueva ruta marítima entre Punta Arenas y las Islas Malvinas genera controversia por sus posibles implicancias diplomáticas entre Argentina y Chile. En medio de versiones sobre una eventual intervención argentina contra un buque comercial, Andrei Serbin Pont analiza los tratados bilaterales, los intereses económicos detrás del proyecto y el papel de ciertos sectores chilenos en la construcción de una narrativa de amenaza externa.
¿Existe realmente un riesgo de conflicto o se trata de una tensión alimentada por intereses internos?

snippet.title: Why the F-16's Seat Leans Back 30 Degrees #shorts
snippet.description:
The F-16 was the first fighter built to pull 9 G: nine times the force of gravity. At 9 G everything weighs nine times more, including the pilot's blood, and the heart can no longer push it up to the brain. So the whole cockpit is built around keeping him awake: a seat that leans back 30 degrees instead of the usual 13 and raises his knees, a g-suit whose air bladders squeeze his legs and belly, and a stick on the right armrest that barely moves and only measures the pressure of his hand. There are no cables or rods: only wires to a computer that keeps the deliberately unstable jet flying, and that will not let him pull more than 9 G. If the single engine fails, a tank of hydrazine spins an emergency turbine for about ten minutes of power. And today, if the pilot still blacks out in a dive, the jet pulls up by itself.

3D model credits:
Aircraft: "F-16 Fighting Falcon" by k.botond431 (CC BY 4.0), landing gear removed, canopy glass remade; the cockpit furniture (seat, consoles, stick, throttle, panel, head-up display) was built for this video
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/f-16-fighting-falcon-f4a4568d8a624026a675090852fb9546
Pilot: "Fighter Pilot Character" by SoftNote (CC BY 4.0), posed, flight suit recoloured
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fighter-pilot-character-9c53b42d13994cefa8916729021b3104

Sky: "Passendorf Snow" HDRI, Poly Haven (CC0). The mountains are generated for this video.

Schematic parts (simplified drawings, not exact shapes or positions): the red / blue figure showing where the blood is, the g-suit bladders, all arrows and angle arcs, the wires and signal dots, the engine, the flight control computer, the emergency power unit and its hydrazine tank, the centre of gravity and lift markers, and the red cables and rods (which the F-16 does not have). The cockpit is simplified.

Sound: real F-16 recordings from U.S. Air Force public-domain footage, via Wikimedia Commons:
"Combined Strike 25 F-16s takeoffs" - U.S. Air Force (Aviano Air Base)
"Exercise Sprint 26-2 F-16 Take Offs" - U.S. Air Force (Misawa Air Base)
Cabin sound: "F18 operation USS Carl Vinson" - U.S. Navy

snippet.title: Low Calorie Giant Egg Bake (26g protein!) 🤤
snippet.description:
Giant Fat Loss Veggie Egg Bake 🥦🍳
225 calories | 26g protein | 14g carbs | 7g fat

INGREDIENTS
-250g broccoli, chopped
-150g red bell pepper, chopped
-150g yellow onion, chopped
-500ml egg whites
-2 whole eggs
-150g low-fat cottage cheese
-30g Parmigiano Reggiano, finely grated
-1/2 tsp garlic powder
-dash salt ;)
-Black pepper

TOPPINGS
-Green onion, chives, chilli flakes
-I topped mine with Greek yogurt and salsa 🤩

METHOD
1. Heat oven to 425°F. Dump the chopped broccoli, onion and red pepper on a pan. Quick spray of oil, salt, and bake until golden (15ish min).
2. While that's cooking, blend egg whites, eggs, cottage cheese, garlic powder, salt + pepper until smooth.
3. Reduce oven to 350°F.
4. Grease an 8x8 baking dish (light spray). Add roasted veggies and pour egg mixture over top.
5. Sprinkle Parmigiano on top.
6. Bake 30-40 min, until the centre is just set. Top will be golden.
7. Rest 5-10 minutes and cut into 4 massive pieces.

Store in the fridge up to 4 days, or freeze. Reheat in the oven at 350°F, covered, for 10-15 min.

ENJOY!!

snippet.title: Jokowi Instruksikan Pemerintahan Prabowo-Gibran Disukseskan, Ini Kata PSI  #short
snippet.description:
Hubungan Presiden Joko Widodo dan Presiden Prabowo Subianto kembali menjadi sorotan setelah Jokowi disebut menginstruksikan untuk menyukseskan pemerintahan Prabowo-Gibran.

Dalam dialog Satu Meja The Forum, hubungan Jokowi dan Prabowo disebut memiliki perjalanan panjang. Keduanya pernah menjadi rival dalam Pilpres 2014 dan 2019, sebelum kemudian berkoalisi setelah Pemilu 2019.

Menurut publik, hubungan Jokowi dan Prabowo sempat dipandang mengalami pasang surut. Terlebih, keduanya disebut sudah beberapa bulan tidak bertemu empat mata. Namun, setelah kembali bertemu dalam sejumlah agenda, termasuk pertemuan terbaru, muncul perhatian publik terhadap hubungan keduanya saat ini.

Hubungan Jokowi dan Prabowo menjadi salah satu pembahasan dalam Satu Meja The Forum, bersama isu reshuffle kabinet dan polemik ijazah Gibran.

Simak dialognya dalam program #SatuMejaTheForum bersama Host KompasTV Radi Saputro selengkapnya di YouTube KompasTV #VODKompasTV
